milestones.title: KALARI
milestones.copy: The first strike. Hanumankind introduces a cadence sharpened by Kerala roots, Houston rap and Bengaluru’s independent circuit.

milestones.title: DAMNSON
milestones.copy: A raw fan favourite turns the underground momentum up and opens a new chapter with Def Jam Recordings India.

milestones.title: BIG DAWGS
milestones.copy: With producer Kalmi and director Bijoy Shetty, a well-of-death in Ponnani becomes the centre of global hip-hop.

milestones.title: MONSOON SEASON
milestones.copy: The homegrown storm keeps travelling: heavier live rooms, sharper world stages and a sound that refuses to dilute itself.
